mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: builders report King main thrust bearings from recent production slipping into the block and cap grooves with no interference fit, raising the risk of a spun thrust main. The snippet states King technical support acknowledged a free-spread spec issue on the affected bearings.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on a BMW forum telling members to measure every King bearing before installation, after a box labelled standard size was found to contain mixed oversize shells. Packaging and size-consistency complaint rather than a material failure.
mentions.replyNote: Returned HTTP 403 Forbidden again with no response body, consistent with every e90post thread in the ledger; thread content still never read.
